title: Release dependent work only from persisted delivery evidence
preconditions: A plan fixture can create waves, work items, dependencies, progress, contracts, and merge events.

steps.action: Create ordered waves and work items with one objective, deliverables, and an explicit dependency condition.
steps.expected_result: The plan preserves each wave, objective, deliverable, and dependency as separate persisted facts.

steps.action: Record progress for the prerequisite without satisfying its release condition.
steps.expected_result: The dependent item remains blocked because progress alone is not delivery.

steps.action: Record the required completion, contract, or integrated merge evidence.
steps.expected_result: Only the matching immutable evidence satisfies the dependency and releases the dependent item.

expected_result: Pass when plan structure persists and dependencies react only to their stated delivery facts; fail if wave order creates an implicit barrier or progress alone releases work.
